scope: Authenticated local world sessions and native credential cancellation
invariant: Derive each session identity from a fresh verified credential proof, and cancel its control when that credential becomes invalid.
required_evidence: Both authorized hosts in Debug and ASan/UBSan
Complete P00-P10 baseline and unchanged acceptance lock
Fresh signed proofs, separate world admission, and production actor actions
Independent native key and button release on revocation, disconnect, and issuer failure
Revocation-consumer mutation detected by a native witness
World sessions against an issuer on the other authorized host
limitations: Inherited local actor channels do not implement remote shared-world transport.
Static baseline action grants do not complete M02 or workspace and application authority.
Issuer acknowledgement is not a distributed cancellation barrier.
